title: Rabbi Chiyya bar Yannai
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Esther Rabbah 7:10, saying: “When the king’s purple is sold in the market, woe to the one who sells it and woe to the one who buys it. So Israel are the purple in which the Holy One, blessed be He, glories,” etc.[^1]

notes.text: Esther Rabbah 7:10 explicitly names Rabbi Chiyya bar Yannai. Its continuation explains the two warnings as woe to the seller and woe to the buyer. The translation follows that order while retaining Hyman’s abbreviated quotation; it does not alter the supplied Hebrew.
